query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT token_hash, id FROM mcp_creds WHERE COALESCE(owner_id = $1, $1 IS NULL) AND ((token_hash, id) > ($4, $3)) AND ($3 IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY token_hash ASC, id ASC LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT token_hash, id FROM mcp_creds WHERE COALESCE(owner_id = $1, $1 IS NULL) AND ($3 IS NULL) ORDER BY token_hash ASC, id ASC LIMIT $2) ORDER BY token_hash ASC, id ASC LIMIT $2) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $5 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN mcp_cred_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.token_hash asc, i.id asc, i.id, e.sequence
